narr: A strong storm system moved through the area on Sunday April 20th, 2025. This system brought tornadoes, damaging wind, large hail and heavy rain. The heavy rainfall led to flooding as the area had already received heavy rainfall from the previous week.
ev: Several reports of street flooding were received from Fort Scott, Kansas. High water caused Gunn and Riverfront Parks to close due to flooding. Flooding is also occurring on 31 Hwy in Bourbon County.
lsr: Street flooding in Fort Scott, Kansas. Closing Gunn Park and Riverfront Park due to flooding. Flooding is also occurring on 31 Hwy in Bourbon County.
